findings.explanation: Ownership of your work product transfers to the Client upon creation before you receive payment, leaving you without leverage if payment is delayed.
findings.suggested_change: Upon receipt of full payment for the applicable Services, ownership of the final deliverables shall transfer to the Client.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, I hope you are having a great week. I have reviewed the agreement and would like to propose a minor adjustment before signing. - Regarding the relevant clause, ownership currently transfers upon creation before payment is received. I propose modifying this so that ownership of the final deliverables transfers upon receipt of full payment for the applicable Services. Thank you for your time and understanding, and I look forward to moving ahead.
